# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the current report version.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API surface, communication patterns, and service contracts.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Data model, persistence patterns, and data ownership notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, and settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core business workflows and decision logic.
